content.text: The text combines excerpts from several works. Evelyn’s diary records London and Wotton life, political events, deaths, weather, family affairs, libraries, and his final years. In *Oh, Money!*, John Smith leaves Hillerton for South America, arrives in Chicago, and marries Maggie Duff; the Blaisdell family remains in Hillerton and later relocates to Plainville. A biography recounts Gordon’s travels from Palestine and Brussels to Cairo and Khartoum, where he organizes the defense during the Mahdist siege; British relief forces move through Egypt, the Bayuda Desert, Jakdul, Abou Klea, and Metemmah but arrive too late. An osteopathic essay condemns tapeworm and gallstone frauds and urges medical honesty. A play set at the Deanery features racing-obsessed relatives, military guests, financial troubles, a fire at the Swan Inn, and Dandy Dick sheltered in the Deanery stables.
